reason_for_correction: The first audit required the previous China row's one-day US return to be exactly reconstructable. That is sufficient but not necessary for validating a compounded endpoint return P_end/P_start-1: the return before P_start is mathematically irrelevant once P_start itself is present at the correct causal boundary.

observed_false_negative_cases_that_trigg.issue: a missing pre-start US level prevents reconstruction of the one-day return into 2018-12-27, but the required start level on 2018-12-27 is present
a missing pre-start US level prevents reconstruction of the one-day return into 2020-01-22, but the required start level on 2020-01-22 is present

corrected_endpoint_contract.start_level_present: NASDAQ and VIX levels are nonmissing on v1_start_us_date
corrected_endpoint_contract.end_level_present: NASDAQ and VIX levels are nonmissing on v1_end_us_date
corrected_endpoint_contract.start_date_is_latest_packaged_joint_date: v1_start_us_date equals the latest joint nonmissing packaged US date strictly before previous China day
corrected_endpoint_contract.end_date_is_latest_packaged_joint_date: v1_end_us_date equals the latest joint nonmissing packaged US date strictly before target China day
corrected_endpoint_contract.no_possible_missing_trading_date_after_s: between v1_start_us_date and previous China day there is no intervening Monday-Friday calendar date; weekends are non-trading for US cash NASDAQ/VIX source observations
corrected_endpoint_contract.target_daily_alignment: target China row's panel us_nasdaq and us_vix_chg exactly match reconstructed daily percentage changes, providing an additional end-boundary cross-check
corrected_endpoint_contract.endpoint_recalculation: stored cumulative values equal end_level/start_level-1 to 1e-12
corrected_endpoint_contract.intermediate_levels: not required for endpoint compounding once causal start/end levels are established

fixed_subset: the same 12 existing holiday_reopen rows in consumed 2019-2020 holdout; no row or threshold search
interpretation_rule: This correction may establish measurement validity of the 12 historical holiday endpoint returns, but it may not promote a holiday rule, refit a model, replace the baseline, or convert consumed holdout evidence into fresh validation.
